Meyers will try to end that drought in a Week 11 clash against the Giants.

Vidal has been productive when he does get touches, rushing 36 times for 162 yards (4.5 YPC) and one touchdown across eight games. He's also caught 10 passes for 56 yards and an additional score.

news.story: Rodriguez was listed on injury reports both of the past two weeks due to the hand issue, but he proceeded to suit up for wins against the Ravens and Titans and handled his usual backup duties behind lead back Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot). Assuming his limitations Wednesday were maintenance-related and not the result of any setback, Rodriguez should be ready to play Sunday against the Giants.

news.story: With Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) making his regular-season debut against Cleveland, Vele's role remained steady, running 44 routes on Tyler Slough's 46 dropbacks. Bryce Lance and Noah Fant appeared to be the bigger losers in terms of playing time and routes. Still, Tyson figures to have an effect on Vele's target potential moving forward, as he's setting in as more of a low-floor WR4/5 in fantasy.

news.headline: Waller didn't practice Wednesday due to a knee issue, and afterward head coach Dave Canales called the tight end's injury a "concern," Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.
news.story: The Panthers' top two tight ends in Waller and Tommy Tremble (knee) showed up as DNPs to begin Week 11 prep, and Canales' "concern" comment also extended to Tremble. It's unclear if either or both are in danger of missing Sunday's game against the Ravens, but Mitchell Evans, Feleipe Franks and Ja'Tavion Sanders are the healthy TEs on Carolina's active roster.

news.story: One week after his 8-90-1 receiving outburst, Waller came back to normalcy in the Panthers' three-man committee at tight end. Waller has big upside, but his ceiling games are difficult to predict. He's been held below 40 yards with no touchdowns in five of nine games this season. Waller will be a low-floor TE2 with upside for Week 11 against the Ravens.

news.story: The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the Steelers. Over…

Brissett completed 33 of 49 passes for 340 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for two yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
news.story: Brissett looked like a natural fit in coordinator Declan Doyle's offense despite having only practiced a handful of days with the Ravens following his trade from the Cardinals, amassing his highest passing yardage total since Week 11 of last season. Vaki (ankle) was a limited participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Vaki has been listed on Lions injury reports over the past two weeks due to the lingering ankle issue, but it hasn't kept him from playing in either contest. With the Lions running away with a 25-point win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10, Vaki saw more work than usual behind lead back Jahmyr Gibbs, finishing with six carries for 28 yards and a 17-yard reception.

news.headline: Vaki turned six carries into 28 yards and added a 17-yard catch on his only target during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
news.story: Lead back Jahmyr Gibbs dominated with 252 yards and three touchdowns on 29 total touches (22 carries, seven catches on eight targets), but Vaki also had his moments during Sunday's game, including a 17-yard catch on the first play of the second quarter. Vaki was working through an ankle issue during Week 10 prep before being cleared to play, and he'll continue to operate in a rotational role in the backfield behind…

news.headline: Vaki (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Patriots in Munich.
news.story: Vaki is playing through an ankle issue for a second straight contest, but last Sunday at Miami he was able to handle an above average 34 percent snap share, indicating he again is good to serve as Jahmyr Gibbs' top backup. On the season, such a workload has amounted to 37 touches for 199 yards from scrimmage and no TDs in eight appearances for Vaki.

news.headline: Mitchell turned three carries into four yards, failed to haul in his lone target and returned two kickoffs for 30 yards during the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday.
news.story: One of Mitchell's carries went for 11 yards, but his other two rushes went for minus-five and minus-two yards, and all of those touches came on the same drive in the second quarter. His 13 offensive snaps were third-most among Chargers running backs behind Kimani Vidal (15) and Omarion Hampton (36), and it was Hampton that commanded the majority of backfield touches, finishing with 22 carries for 105 yards and a…

news.headline: Mitchell (hip) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Ravens.
news.story: Mitchell's practice reps were limited by a hip injury, but he's been officially cleared to play Monday against the team he spent three seasons with from 2023 to 2025. He turned 10 touches into 67 yards during the Chargers' Week 9 loss to the Texans, and Mitchell will continue to operate in a rotational role in the backfield alongside Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal.

news.headline: Mitchell (hip) remained limited at practice Friday.
news.story: It's a new injury for Mitchell, who also was limited Thursday when the Chargers filed their first practice report for the upcoming Monday night game at Baltimore. He'll have some extra motivation, facing his former team in primetime as his current team seeks its first win of the season.

news.headline: Jones carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and a touchdown and caught his only target for eight yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: Jordan Mason led the Vikings with 59 rushing yards, but Jones had the more productive afternoon as he scored his first TD since Week 5 on a one-yard plunge in the second quarter. Jones' upside will remain limited while working in a timeshare with Mason, but he's still got some utility heading into a Week 11 clash with the 49ers.

news.headline: Fantasy football: Which players can you trust from these backfields-by-committee?
Jones rushed five times for 16 yards and brought in his only target for five yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.
news.story: Jones and backfield mate Jordan Mason combined for just 11 carries on an abysmal night for the Vikings offense, and the latter was much more efficient than Jones by averaging 5.8 yards per carry on his six totes. Jones now has seen his rushing yardage totals drop in three straight games, and Mason's return from injured reserve has played a role in the former seeing just 18 total carries in the last three contests.…

news.headline: Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while adding five carries for nine yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
news.story: Jones failed to eclipse the 200-yard mark for the fourth straight game while throwing multiple picks for the second time in that span. Neither turnover led to any Dolphins points, and Jones also threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to new interim No. 1 receiver Laquon Treadwell in the second quarter. Jones has completed just 59.6 percent of his passes and has a 7:12 TD:INT across 10 games, and with Indianapolis devoid…

news.headline: Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.
news.story: With Bam Knight back in the lineup in Week 10 after one absence due to a concussion, Allgeier didn't reach double-digit touches for the first time since Week 5, a span in which the latter's 65 touches went for 334 yards from scrimmage and two total TDs. Knight himself found a similar lack of success Sunday with just 19 yards on his five rushes. Because the Cardinals racked up just 123 yards of offense in rookie QB…

news.story: Filling his customary workhorse role in Miami's ground attack, Gordon handled all but four of the Dolphins' running back carries while finishing with a team-high reception total. The second-year back eclipsed 75 rushing yards for the fourth time in six games in the process, and Gordon's catch and receiving yardage totals were also season highs. Gordon should remain in a high-volume role in a Week 11 road matchup…

news.story: Burden's status was up in the air for a bit with the Bears going on bye immediately after he sustained a concussion in a Week 9 win over the Buccaneers, but he was spotted working out on the field with teammates Monday and has apparently cleared all five phases of the protocol. The second-year wideout looks like he'll be a full practice participant throughout Week 11, and he shouldn't face any playing-time…

news.headline: Burden (concussion) was spotted participating in the Bears' unofficial practice session Monday, AllCHGO.com reports.
news.story: Burden was diagnosed with a concussion after making a late exit in the Bears' previous game Nov. 8 against the Buccaneers, but he appears to have made some progress through the five-step protocol since Chicago went on bye for Week 10. Though head coach Ben Johnson hasn't confirmed that Burden has cleared the protocol, if the wideout is deemed a full participant Wednesday in the Bears' first official practice of…

news.headline: Fant failed to haul in his lone target during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
news.story: Fant didn't connect with Tyler Shough on a short pass late in the first quarter, and that ended up being the only target for the veteran tight end. Fant has a 12-96-3 line on 19 targets through eight regular-season games, although he's logged one reception or zero in four of his last five outings. news.headline: Fant Donaldson (back) upgraded to full participation at Thursday's practice.
news.story: Fant was limited at Wednesday's practice, but the veteran TE faced no limitations Thursday, suggesting that he'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers. He has worked as the Saints' No. 2 option at the position behind Juwan Johnson.

news.headline: Fant (back) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: Fant may have tweaked his back during the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns in Week 9, when he finished with one catch on two targets for 12 yards. He'll have two more opportunities to increase his practice participation ahead of Sunday's NFC South tilt against the Panthers. Fant has accumulated 12 catches on 18 targets for 96 yards and three touchdowns through seven regular-season games.

news.headline: St. Brown caught four of five targets for 98 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
news.story: The Lions didn't need to throw it much, as Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game for the Patriots early. It was St. Brown's third multi-TD game of the season but his first since Week 2, and he'll…

news.story: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three…

news.headline: The Jaguars have relayed to inquiring teams that they intend to keep Thomas through Tuesday's trade deadline, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: After sending out a first-round pick, two second-round picks, a fifth-round pick and a sixth-round pick Monday in separate deals to bring in defenders Jordan Davis, Jessie Bates and Davon Godchaux, the Jaguars likely could have recouped some of that draft capital if they had opted to move Thomas. Instead, Fowler indicates that the Jaguars plan to keep the rest of their roster intact ahead of the deadline, which…

news.headline: Mooney caught two of five targets for eight yards Thursday in a loss to Washington.
news.story: Mooney logged the third-most targets of any New York pass catcher, but he managed just two short receptions. Efficiency has been an issue for the veteran wideout throughout the campaign, as he's hauled in only 14 of 30 targets through nine contests. Mooney has finished with fewer than 10 yards in four of his past six appearances, so he's not a viable fantasy play at the moment.

news.headline: Mooney (chest) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
news.story: Listed as a limited participant for Monday's walk-through practice, Mooney took every rep a day later to erase any concern about his status heading into Thursday's game against the Commanders. The veteran wideout has played more than 50 percent of the offensive snaps in all but one of the Giants' eight games to date, but he exceeded two receptions and 50 receiving yards for the first time all season in this past…

news.headline: Mooney (chest) was estimated to be a limited participant at the Giants' walkthrough practice Monday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
news.story: Mooney reeled in a season-high three passes for 54 yards and also had a rush for minus-4 yards during Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles. The wide receiver may have picked up a chest injury during the victory, and as a result, he was considered to be less than 100 percent Monday. Mooney will have two more chances to be upgraded to a full participant prior to Thursday night's matchup with the Commanders.

news.story: The latest installment in what is looking like an MVP-worthy campaign for Burrow included quite a milestone, as the 2020 first overall pick became the only other player in NFL history beside Peyton Manning in 2004 to score four-plus total touchdowns in five consecutive games. news.story: Williams was a distant second to Stefon Diggs in receiving yards for the Commanders on the night, but like the latter, the former was on the receiving end of one of Jayden Daniels' three touchdown passes. Williams scored from 31 yards out just past the midway point of the third quarter, his first touchdown since way back in Week 1 against the Eagles. news.headline: Williams caught three passes for 25 yards on six targets in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.
news.story: With Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the year, Williams led the team's wide receivers and tight ends in snaps and routes against Los Angeles, but it was a tough matchup against a top-tier pass defense. Williams should have better games moving forward in one of the league's pass-happiest offenses. The rookie wideout should be a full-time player down the stretch in the second half of the season.

news.headline: Perine turned six carries into 14 yards and a touchdown and hauled in all four of his targets for 25 yards during the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.story: It looked like Chase Brown found the end zone in the fourth quarter for his third score of the game, but replay assist revealed that his knee came down just short of the goal line. Perine came in on the next play and took the ball for a one-yard touchdown to extend the Bengals' lead to 38-10 following Evan MacPherson's successful extra-point try. It was Perine's third touchdown of the season and first since Week 7…

news.headline: Perine rushed 11 times for 43 yards during Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.story: Perine logged two more carries than Chase Brown in the game, but Brown out-produced him with 57 rushing yards. Perine has continued to operate in a modest role as the Bengals' No. 2 option in the backfield, and he would stand to be a valuable fantasy asset in the case that Brown is forced to miss any action down the road this season.

news.story: Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs monopolized the Lions' offense on the day, scoring four of the team's five TDs, and there wasn't much production left over for Williams. Lane brought in three of 11 targets for 61 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
news.story: Lane was far from efficient during his first opportunity to work with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett, but he parlayed his career-high target total into a career-best yardage tally. The fact the rookie third-round pick garnered so much of Brissett's attention was certainly encouraging, and Lane could emerge as a much more consistent No. 3 option in the offense in coming weeks.

news.story: Thomas continues to see limited action offensively, playing just five snaps Sunday and no more than 15 on offense in any game this season, though he did manage to record his seventh reception of the season. The rookie third-round pick should continue to see the majority of his action come on special teams, and he's now amassed 715 kick-return yards across nine outings this season.

news.headline: Price is set for an increase in offensive workload with Jordan Addison (thumb) sidelined, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.

The wideout was operating in a more prominent offensive role for the second week in a row with Jauan Jennings (calf) sidelined, and fellow wide receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) was unable to play as well. news.story: Price wasn't the only Minnesota pass catcher who logged an inefficient line, as starting quarterback Carson Wentz completed just eight of 25 pass attempts. Price did make an impact in the return game by averaging 31.0 yards on his four kickoff returns. Price's role continues to be mostly centered on special teams, as he's caught just four passes for 32 yards on 11 targets through eight games.

Johnson has been working as the Bucs' WR3 behind Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin, with rookie Ted Hurst mixing in for sub-package snaps. Johnson isn't a particularly exciting fantasy bet.

After fellow wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Restrepo will replace him on the active roster ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cowboys.

news.story: After being elevated ahead of Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars, Restrepo finished with three receptions for 31 yards. The wide receiver played 19 offensive snaps and 14 special-teams snaps in the contest. Restrepo can be elevated on more occasion before the Titans would need to add him to the 53-man roster in order for him to be eligible to play.

news.story: Lane was far from efficient during his first opportunity to work with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett, but he parlayed his career-high target total into a career-best yardage tally. The fact the rookie third-round pick garnered so much of Brissett's attention was certainly encouraging, and Lane could emerge as a much more consistent No. 3 option in the offense in coming weeks.

news.story: Davis continues to be sparsely utilized on offense -- he has two or fewer touches in six of eight contests so far this season. news.story: With Jordyn Tyson playing his second game since debuting last week, the rookie wideout was targeted 13 times on Tyler Shough's 35 pass attempts. It didn't leave much for the rest of New Orleans' pass catchers, as Travis Etienne was actually second on the team with five targets. Over his last five games, Johnson has nine catches for 85 yards and a score. He's become a low-end TE2 for fantasy.

news.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Mendoza, Douglas, Estime among top options
Ogunbowale reverted to the Texans' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
news.story: Ogunbowale was elevated to the active roster to operate as a depth option in the backfield behind Woody Marks (concussion) in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. The running back rushed one time for two yards while reeling in his only target for 13 yards in the defeat. With Marks potentially sidelined with a concussion and David Montgomery (groin) uncertain for Week 11, Ogunbowale could be elevated again ahead of…

news.headline: The Texans signed Ogunbowale to the practice squad and elevated him to the active roster Saturday.
news.story: Ogunbowale was released by the Texans on Thursday after appearing in each of the team's five prior games. He's opted to stay in Houston as a member of the practice squad, and his elevation to the 53-man roster comes after David Montgomery (groin) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns. Ogunbowale and Emari Demercado will provide depth for the Texans behind lead back Woody Marks in Week 10.

news.headline: The Texans released Ogunbowale on Thursday.
news.story: Ogunbowale mostly served on special teams while providing backfield depth across his five regular-season appearances with the Texans, but his services are no longer needed given that David Montgomery (groin) is progressing in his recovery. Ogunbowale will now have the opportunity to explore his next options, and he should garner interest from teams looking for veteran depth at running back.

news.headline: The Eagles signed Ertz from the practice squad to the active roster Monday.
news.story: Philadelphia is coming off a Week 10 bye, but prior to the midseason respite, there were no reported injuries in the TE group on the active roster. When the position group was depleted earlier this season, the team used elevations on Ertz from Weeks 3-5, but his snap share decreased game by game (38, 21 and 11 percent), while he hauled in three of eight targets for 22 yards in that span. Wednesday's practice report…

news.headline: Bateman brought in three of five targets for 42 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
news.story: Bateman put together a solid performance during his first opportunity to work with Jacoby Brissett, posting his best receiving yardage total since Week 5. The veteran wideout also recorded multiple receptions for the first time in three games, and two of his three catches went for first downs. Bateman seemed to lay a solid foundation with his new signal-caller, and he'll look to continue building on it in a Week 11…

news.headline: Bateman (calf) was listed as a full participant on Friday's practice estimation.
news.story: After being limited at practice Thursday, the starting wideout is in line to face the Chargers on Monday night after being deemed 'FP' on Friday. While Bateman has turned in two consecutive one-catch efforts, there's a chance that working with the team's new QB Jacoby Brissett could spark some added production for the 2021 first-rounder while working alongside top WR Zay Flowers.

news.headline: Bateman (calf) was limited in practice Thursday.
news.story: Bateman now has two more opportunities to practice fully and thus avoid an injury designation prior to Monday night's game against the Chargers. The starting wideout is coming off back-to-back one-catch efforts, but he'll perhaps have an opportunity to bounce back against 0-8 Los Angeles, while working with a new QB in Jacoby Brissett.

news.headline: Latu caught his lone target for a 25-yard touchdown Monday in a 23-6 win against the Vikings.
news.story: Latu gave the Bills the lead late in the first half when he got open in the back of the end zone and caught a pass from Josh Allen. It was not only his first catch of the campaign but also his first NFL touchdown. Latu has worked primarily on special teams this season, and despite his score Monday, he isn't likely to suddenly be a big part of the passing game given the fact that Dalton Kincaid, Dawson Knox and…

news.headline: Head coach Kellen Moore said Tyson was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a chest injury, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.
news.story: Tyson missed the first seven games of the campaign due to a hamstring issue, but he increased his sway in the Saints offense from Week 9 to 10, upping his snap share (24 to 71 percent) and target count (five to 13). In this past Sunday's loss to the Panthers, he recorded an 11-80-0 line, but he emerged from that contest with a new health concern. As a result, Tyson's status will be monitored in advance of Sunday's…

news.headline: Rest-of-season rankings: Joe Burrow takes QB lead, Chuba Hubbard continues rise
Why Jordyn Tyson is Field Yates' No. 1 waiver wire pickup
Monangai (toe) was listed as a full participant on Wednesday's practice estimate.
news.story: Monangai told Courtney Cronin of ESPN on Monday that he's "on track" to return Sunday against the Saints, and after being spotted in full pads at Tuesday's unofficial practice, the running back would have logged an uncapped session one day later if the team had held drills. Monangai is seeking his first game action since Week 4, when he initially suffered a turf toe injury and a right thumb concern.

news.headline: Monangai (toe/thumb) was seen wearing full pads for the Bears' unofficial practice Tuesday, Adam Jahns of AllCHGO.com reports.
news.story: After their Week 10 bye, the Bears won't post their first Week 11 practice report until Wednesday, but Monangai may be trending toward being listed as a full participant. The second-year back was on the field for a second straight day Tuesday and didn't appear to be operating with any limitations while mixing into drills. Monangai had missed the Bears' previous five games due to turf toe and a right thumb injury,…

news.headline: Monangai (thumb/toe) said Monday that he's "on track" to return to action Sunday against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN reports.
news.story: Monangai was a limited practice participant Nov. 6, which marked his first on-field work since suffering a turf toe injury Oct. 4 versus the Jets. He still missed his fifth consecutive game as a result of that injury and a right thumb issue, but after a Week 10 bye, he's aiming to resume game action. "The time off definitely helped, but I mean it's going to be there," Monangai relayed about the toe concern.…

news.headline: Meyers caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown while also adding 58 yards as a kick returner during Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Meyers reeled in multiple passes for the third straight game, and he was able to secure his first score of the year in the second quarter on a 15-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow. The 26-year-old's 28 offensive snaps ranked fourth at wide receiver for Cincinnati behind Ja'Marr Chase (59), Tee Higgins (51) and Colbie Young (29). With Andrei Iosivas (thumb) nearing a return to action, Meyers may see a sharp drop…

news.headline: Meyers caught two passes for 47 yards on three targets in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.story: With Andrei Iosivas (thumb) on injured reserve, Meyers has settled in as the Bengals' third receiver behind target hogs Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. Meyers would need an injury to one of those two to become relevant again in fantasy.

news.headline: Conklin went without a target while playing 22 of the Lions' 71 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
news.story: A healthy inactive for two of the Lions' first four games of the season, Conklin has now suited up for five consecutive contests. However, the veteran tight end has been handling a limited role, logging less than one-third of the offensive snaps in any of his seven appearances on the season while compiling a 2-11-0 receiving line on three targets.

news.headline: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.
news.story: Sinnott gave the Commanders a lead just before halftime when he reeled in a one-yard touchdown from Jayden Daniels. It was his first TD of the season and the third of his career. Sinnott's four grabs came out of nowhere, as he'd logged just one catch on two targets through his first eight games of the season. He also ranked third among Washington tight ends Thursday with 24 offensive snaps -- behind Chig Okonkwo…

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate Sunday
Mahomes completed 22 of 35 passes for 348 yards with five touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
news.story: Taking advantage of a controlled environment and a fast track at Mercedes-Benz Stadium -- not to mention the presence of the debuting Josh Downs -- Mahomes repeatedly exploited the vulnerabilities of the Falcons defense throughout the afternoon. The legendary signal-caller showed no ill effects from the elbow injury that he'd suffered in Week 9, and he connected with Emmett Johnson (12, six yards), Downs (18…

news.headline: Why fantasy managers should keep riding the hot hand with Patrick Mahomes
Johnston brought in his sole target for six yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
news.story: The speedster was poised to see some added involvement with Ladd McConkey (back) sidelined, but that never materialized on a night when 86 of Justin Herbert's 129 passing yards went to Tre' Harris. Johnston's yardage total was a season-low figure, and he's now been limited to one reception in four of the last five games. Johnston's often been able to offset the modest catch totals with big plays, but that clearly…

news.headline: Bell (knee) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Bell was sidelined for the Dolphins' final two Week 10 practices before being listed as doubtful and ultimately ruled out ahead of Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts, but the rookie wideout looks to be in a better spot on the health front in Week 11. After head coach Jeff Hafley described Bell as day-to-day prior to Wednesday's session, the receiver was able to turn in a limited practice. Bell will likely need to…

news.headline: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said that Bell (knee) is viewed as day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Bell, who was inactive for Miami's Week 10 loss to the Colts, didn't practice this past Thursday and Friday after taking what Hafley described as a hit to his knee. While Bell wsa sidelined versus Indianapolis, Kevin Coleman logged added snaps alongside starting receivers Malik Washington and Caleb Douglas.

news.headline: Bell (knee) is inactive for Sunday's Week 10 matchup against the Colts.
news.story: The rookie sat out both Thursday and Friday's practices before being given a doubtful designation for Sunday's contest, and his inactive status is now official. With Bell, who'd posted a 7-56-0 line on 10 targets in Weeks 7 and 8 before being blanked against the Lions in Week 9, sitting out Sunday, Kevin Coleman and Jalen Tolbert could share No. 3 receiver snaps while working with new starting quarterback Kyle…

news.headline: Daniels is slated to take all of the first-teams reps Wednesday with Baker Mayfield (foot) sidelined for the Buccaneers' first Week 11 practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
news.story: While the Buccaneers aren't ruling Mayfield out from playing Sunday in Detroit, the fact that he'll be a spectator in practice coming out of a Week 10 bye suggests that Daniels has the early edge on the Week 11 start. Per Auman, Mayfield appeared to be walking normally off to the side during Wednesday's practice, which could indicate that he'll attempt to test out his strained foot during Thursday's session. The…

news.headline: Daniels "seems to be trending" toward drawing the start at quarterback for the Buccaneers on Sunday in Detroit while Baker Mayfield tends to a foot strain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
news.story: Mayfield injured his foot late in a Week 9 loss to the Bears, and after he was in and out of a walking boot during the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, his status is firmly up in the air for Week 11. Since Mayfield has shown a willingness to play at well below 100 percent in the past, the Buccaneers will likely wait until the end of the week to see where he stands on the health front before naming a starter for Sunday, but…

news.headline: Abanikanda reverted to the Cowboys' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
news.story: Abanikanda made his 2026 regular-season debut against the 49ers in Week 10, when he operated as the Cowboys' RB2 behind Javonte Williams. Abanikanda finished that contest with two carries for eight yards and a two-yard catch on his lone target in what ended as a 46-40 loss for Dallas. With both Tyler Goodson (knee) and Malik Davis (hip) on injured reserve, Abanikanda figures to be elevated to the Cowboys' active…

news.headline: The Cowboys elevated Abanikanda from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
news.story: With Tyler Goodson (knee) on injured reserve and Malik Davis (hip, IR) out for the rest of the year, Abanikanda is expected to operate as the Cowboys' RB2 behind Javonte Williams for the foreseeable future, starting with Sunday's game against the 49ers. Abanikanda last saw regular-season action in 2023, when he logged 22 carries for 70 yards (3.2 YPC) and added seven catches on 11 targets for 43 yards across six…

news.headline: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said Friday that Abanikanda likely will be promoted from the practice squad to replace Tyler Goodson (knee) as the No. 2 running back ahead of Sunday's matchup with San Francisco, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.
news.story: A 2024 fifth-round pick, Abanikanda has six regular-season appearances and 29 career touches -- all back in 2023 for the Jets. He offers sub-4.5 speed at 215-plus pounds, but he won't necessarily have the same role as Goodson, who earned the team's trust with solid performances after latching on earlier this fall. With Abanikanda as the No. 2 back, Javonte Williams may be tasked with even larger workloads than…

news.headline: Montgomery (groin) doesn't have an injury designation and is expected to play in Thursday's game against the Colts, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
news.story: Montgomery was sidelined for the Texans' past four games due to the groin injury, but he's good to go for the Week 11 matchup after he was listed as a full practice participant from Monday through Wednesday. Before going down with the injury, Montgomery had been part of a timeshare with Woody Marks, but Montgomery will have a fairly clear path to a lead role Thursday with Marks sidelined due to a concussion.…

news.headline: Fantasy football matchup ranks: Upgrade Jonah Coleman, downgrade Brock Purdy
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans confirmed that Montgomery (groin) is trending toward playing in Thursday's game against the Colts, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.
news.story: Montgomery has been sidelined for the Texans' past four games, but he concluded Week 10 prep as a full practice participant and appears to have shown continued improvement in his recovery from the groin injury in Week 11. After being listed as a full participant for Monday's walkthrough, Montgomery was on the practice field again Tuesday, with Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston noting that the 29-year-old was "feeling…

news.headline: Stover was a healthy inactive for Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.
news.story: Week 9 marked the first time all season that Stover sat out, with the Texans opting to keep their other four tight ends (Dalton Schultz, Foster Moreau, Brevin Jordan and Marlin Klein) active ahead of him. Through the Texans' first seven games, Stover had played less than half of the offensive snaps in each contest and recorded three receptions for 17 yards on five targets while rushing three times for five yards.

news.headline: Gray caught one of three targets for six yards during Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
news.story: Gray was unable to reel in multiple passes for the second straight week after he had at least two catches in each of the team's previous five games prior to Week 9. The tight end did play a season-high 53 offensive snaps with Travis Kelce being limited to just 18 snaps on offense as a result of an ankle injury. If Kelce is forced to be limited or even miss the team's Week 11 matchup with Arizona, Gray would stand…

news.headline: Gray caught his only target for 11 yards Sunday in a 35-12 win against the Jets.
news.story: Gray was a minor factor in the passing game, with his lone reception gaining 11 yards late in the third quarter. Meanwhile, No. 1 tight end Travis Kelce paced Kansas City with 72 receiving yards on four catches. Gray had a nice two-game run with a combined six catches for 97 yards across Weeks 6 and 7, but since then he's tallied just three receptions for 26 yards and a touchdown across his subsequent two games.

news.headline: Higgins played 24 of 35 offensive snaps (68.6 percent) but didn't get a target during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
news.story: Week 10 was Higgins' first game since signing a three-year contract extension worth up to $26.8 million. He didn't have much to show for it during Sunday's loss, although the Cardinals finished with a measly 17:37 time of possession, and the offense struggled as a whole with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck under center. Higgins will take an 18-162-1 receiving line on 20 targets through 10 games into Arizona's Week…

news.headline: Higgins is signing a contract extension with the Cardinals through 2029, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Higgins was scheduled for free agency after this season, and he's taken on a larger role as the year has progressed, helping the Cardinals get by with limited talent at wide receiver. Higgins has 18 catches for 162 yards and a touchdown on 20 targets, serving as a complementary receiving option alongside Trey McBride when the Cardinals use multi-TE formations. Higgins figures to stick in that role long-term and…

news.headline: Higgins caught both of his targets for 11 yards in Sunday's 17-3 loss to the Seahawks.
news.story: With all of the injuries at wide receiver for Arizona, Higgins played a season-high 66 percent of the offensive snaps in Seattle. It still didn't translate to an elevated role in the pass game. Higgins has 18 grabs for 162 yards and a touchdown on 20 targets across nine games this season.

news.headline: Briningstool caught one of two targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 35-13 win against the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Briningstool connected with Patrick Mahomes for a 20-yard reception midway through the first quarter but didn't record another reception. The 23-year-old tight end has exactly one catch in each of his past three games. That's not enough production to warrant fantasy consideration, but Briningstool is at least showing growth as a pass catcher, as he had just one catch on two targets over his first six contests of…

news.headline: Long (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Long was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and the sixth-year pro has been cleared to return from a five-game absence due to a knee injury. He will operate in a rotational role at tight end behind Trey McBride and Elijah Higgins.

news.headline: Arizona activated Long (knee) from injured reserve Saturday, and he remains questionable for Sunday's battle against the Rams.
news.story: Long had been on IR since Oct. 6 after suffering a knee injury during Week 4 against the Giants. He was limited in all three of the Cardinals' practice sessions this week but could suit up Sunday. If Long plays, he'll work as a depth tight end behind Trey McBride and Elijah Higgins, though Long could still have some pass-catching opportunities given how depleted the team's wideout corps is.

news.headline: The Cardinals designated Long (knee) for return from injured reserve Wednesday.
news.story: The tight end was injured in Week 4 against the Giants but had his 21-day practice window opened Wednesday. Elijah Higgins and Teagan Quitoriano have been soaking up the snaps at the position behind Trey McBride in recent weeks.

news.headline: Evans caught both of his two targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 26-21 loss versus the Broncos.
news.story: For the third game in a row, Evans drew exactly two targets and caught both of them Sunday. With that said, he also again trailed in snaps at tight end (31) behind teammates Tommy Tremble (46) and Darren Waller (35), both of whom also drew more targets in Week 9. Evans' role in the Panthers' passing offense isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats going into a Week 10 matchup at New Orleans.

news.headline: Young was listed with a sore foot on Wednesday's injury report but was a full participant in the Panthers' first Week 11 practice.
news.story: Per Steve Reed of the Associated Press, head coach Dave Canales said that Young experienced some soreness in his foot coming out of Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. However, after receiving treatment over the last couple of days, Young responded well enough to take every rep in practice to kick off Week 11 prep. The signal-caller isn't expected to face any limitations during this Sunday's matchup with the Ravens.

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate Sunday
Young completed 17 of 30 passes for 200 yards without a touchdown or interception in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. He added one rushing yard on his only carry.
news.story: Chuba Hubbard did most of the heavy lifting on offense for the Panthers, piling up 172 scrimmage yards and both the team's touchdowns. It's the first time this season Young failed to throw a TD, but it was also the first time since Week 6 he avoided committing a turnover. The fourth-year QB will take a 16:6 TD:INT through nine games into a Week 11 clash against the Ravens.

news.headline: Knox caught one of his three targets for seven yards in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Knox continues to receive targets as the No. 2 tight end in the Bills offense. The 30-year-old has consistently struggled to bring in catchable balls over the past few contests but remains a valuable part of Buffalo's 13-personnel packages as a blocker and receiving threat. Knox played 41 offensive snaps in Sunday's game and was on the field for 72 percent of the Bills' offensive plays.

news.headline: Knox caught four passes for 37 yards on five targets in Monday night's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.story: Knox's targets, catches and yards were all season highs. He also played 58 offensive snaps against Minnesota. With the blitz-happy Vikings defense opposite them, the Buffalo offense went with heavy tight end sets to try and get more blockers on the field. Knox won't be a recommended fantasy target for Sunday's game against the Jets. He has 13 grabs for 79 yards and a touchdown across eight games this season.

news.headline: Johnson caught his only target for four yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: For the third time in seven appearances this season, Johnson didn't log a single carry. The veteran running back also didn't have much of a role in the passing game with just one target. In fact, Johnson tallied just 10 offensive snaps, finishing behind both starter James Cook (35) and fellow backup Ray Davis (12). Johnson has had a few productive performances as a pass catcher this season, but his role is too…

news.headline: Johnson rushed once for one yard and caught both of his targets for 36 yards against the Vikings in a 23-6 victory Monday.
news.story: Johnson got just one carry while workhorse No. 1 RB James Cook logged a hearty 31 totes. However, Johnson made one big play as a receiver, hauling in a 36-yard reception on a third-down play early in the third quarter to bring Buffalo into Vikings territory. While Johnson has been nearly invisible as a ball carrier this season, he's been effective in a pass-catching role, racking up 210 yards on 17 catches through…

news.headline: Hawes (shoulder) was a late addition to Wednesday's injury report, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News.
news.story: It is unclear whether Hawes suffered his shoulder injury during last Sunday's win over the Jets or if the issue occurred late in Wednesday's practice. Hawes' eligibility for Week 11 against the Dolphins will likely be decided during the Thursday and Friday prep sessions. The 25-year-old will need to upgrade to a full participant by Friday's practice to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's contest.

news.headline: Hawes caught his lone target for eight yards during Buffalo's win over the Vikings on Monday.
news.story: Hawes played a season-high 46 snaps on offense and also played eight snaps on special teams. The 25-year-old has now caught a pass in consecutive games after failing to record any receptions across his first six outings of the campaign.

news.headline: Kacmarek (quadriceps) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Kacmarek upgraded his practice participation in each Week 10 prep session. The tight end went from a non-participant Wednesday to a full participant by Friday's session. Kacmarek is all set to suit up as the No. 2 tight end behind Greg Dulcich for Sunday's game against the Colts.

news.headline: Kacmarek (quadriceps) did not practice Wednesday, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.
news.story: The rookie tight end previously dealt with a hamstring injury before injuring his quad in last Sunday's loss to the Lions. A block-first tight end, Kacmarek has four catches for 30 yards on nine targets across eight games this season.

news.headline: Traore went without a target while playing six of the Dolphins' 69 snaps on offense in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts.
news.story: Meanwhile, Traore tied a season-high with 23 snaps on special teams, where he continues to receive the bulk of his playing time. The reserve tight end has played in all nine of the Dolphins' games to date but has gone without a reception while being targeted once across 39 total snaps on offense.

news.headline: Roush caught both of his two targets for 23 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Buccaneers.
news.story: Roush, who has been utilized heavily as a blocker through nine games, achieved a new career high in receiving yards in Week 9. Roush has been relatively efficient with his limited targets so far this season, but Colston Loveland should be expected to continue to handle a substantial majority of the Bears' pass-catching duties at tight end as long as he's available.

news.headline: Tate (shoulder) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: Back at practice for the first time since Week 7, Tate operated with a cap on his reps. So long as he progresses to full participation at some point over the next two days, Tate should be on track to end his two-game absence this Sunday in Dallas. The rookie first-round pick had seen most of his snaps on the perimeter over the Titans' first seven games, but he could be in store for more snaps out of the slot moving…

news.headline: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Tate (shoulder) will practice Wednesday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Tate has been sidelined for the Titans' past two games and wasn't able to practice in advance of either contest while he managed the shoulder injury, but he'll take a notable step forward in his recovery by getting back on the field. While the Titans won't reveal until after practice concludes whether Tate was a full or limited participant, the rookie's involvement in the team's first Week 11 session is generally a…

news.headline: Garrett Wilson vs. Carnell Tate: Clay and Yates pick a side for Week 11
Spann-Ford caught one of three targets for 26 yards during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
news.story: Spann-Ford operated as the Cowboys' No. 1 tight end in Week 10 due to the absence of Jake Ferguson (knee). However, George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy were the top targets for Dak Prescott. Ferguson is expected to be sidelined for multiple weeks while recovering from his injury, so Spann-Ford should once again top the depth chart in Week 11 against a Titans team that has given up 40-plus points in each…

news.headline: Spann-Ford caught two of three targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 27-23 win versus the Colts.
news.story: Spann-Ford opened Week 9 in his typical reserve role behind Jake Ferguson at tight end, but Ferguson suffered a knee injury in the third quarter. With Ferguson set to miss multiple weeks of action, Spann-Ford will have a chance to operate as the team's primary option at tight end beginning in Week 10 versus the 49ers. On the season thus far, Spann-Ford has reeled in 19 of 27 targets for 136 yards and four…

news.headline: Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
news.story: After a career day last time out in Week 8 against the Bengals, Helm's box score looked more familiar against Jacksonville's stout defense. He's been held below 30 yards in eight of nine games this season and has yet to catch a touchdown. Helm is a member of the large bucket of low-floor TE2 options in fantasy.

news.headline: Dike caught two passes for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.
news.story: With Carnell Tate (shoulder) out again, Dike played 54 of 57 offensive snaps against Jacksonville, but his three targets were a distant fifth on the team and represented just an 8.1 percent target share. Outside of his 5-71-1 receiving outburst in Week 8 against Cincinnati, Dike has amassed eight catches for 69 scoreless yards. He's not a reliable fantasy option, though a Week 11 date with Dallas' secondary awaits…

news.headline: Dike may have a significant role on offense with Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out for Sunday's game against Jacksonville.
news.story: Tate also missed the previous game, before a Week 9 bye, when Dike caught five of six targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime loss to Cincinnati. Dike played 83 percent of snaps in the contest, running more routes (33) than both Elic Ayomanor (30) and Calvin Ridley (22). The 70-percent route share was easily a season high for Dike, and his performance suggests a sizable role should be coming again…

news.headline: Bellinger caught two of three targets for six yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
news.story: The blocking specialist played 28 of 57 offensive snaps and was asked to block on 12 of those plays. His two-yard touchdown in the second quarter was Bellinger's first of the season. For the year, Bellinger has 11 grabs for 76 yards and the score on 18 targets across nine contests.

news.headline: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: Mingo was held out of practice all week while recovering from foot and ankle injuries that he picked up during the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9. In his absence, KaVontae Turpin -- who is returning from a three-game absence due to a rib injury -- and Camden Brown are both in line for a slight uptick in offensive snaps. Mingo's next chance to play is Week 11 against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 22.

news.headline: Mingo (ankle, foot) did not practice Thursday, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Mingo didn't practice for a second consecutive day due to foot and ankle issues. He logged a season-high 31 offensive snaps in the narrow win over the Colts in Week 9. Mingo could be busier than usual once again versus the 49ers if KaVontae Turpin (ribs) and George Pickens (hamstring) miss another game. However, Mingo will need to be cleared to suit up for that to happen.

news.headline: Schoonmaker caught one of two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: Schoonmaker garnered a season-high two targets, but he failed to produce his first multicatch performance of the year. The tight end played 28 offensive snaps in contest, ranking second at his position behind Brevyn Spann-Ford (55) and ahead of James Mitchell (five). With Jake Ferguson (knee) expected to remain sidelined in Week 11, Schoonmaker will have another chance to operate as the team's top reserve option at…

news.headline: Schoonmaker (groin) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: The tight end has missed the past two games for Dallas, but appears to be ready to return and could see significant snaps behind Brevyn Spann-Ford while Jake Ferguson (knee) is sidelined.

news.headline: The Cowboys signed Mitchell from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
news.story: The Cowboys technically still have one elevation to use on Mitchell this season, but they instead will opt to sign him to the active roster for Week 10. His signing gives the Cowboys extra depth at tight end, as the team will be without Jake Ferguson (knee) for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.headline: Mitchell reverted to the Cowboys' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
news.story: Mitchell failed to record any stats while playing 10 offensive snaps and 11 snaps with the special-teams unit after being elevated for the second straight week prior to Sunday's 27-23 win over Indianapolis. With fellow tight end Jake Ferguson (knee) expected to miss multiple weeks, there's a good chance Mitchell is elevated again in Week 10 versus the 49ers.

news.headline: Ferguson didn't practice Wednesday due to knee and ankle injuries and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Ferguson injured his knee in a Week 9 win over the Colts, while the ankle issue is more of a lingering concern after he initially sustained a low sprain in a Week 8 loss to the Cardinals. Head coach Brian Schottenheimer previously announced Nov. 9 that Ferguson was set to miss multiple weeks, so the tight end's continued absence from practice comes as little surprise. In Ferguson's stead, Brevyn Spann-Ford should…

news.headline: According to coach Brian Schottenheimer, Ferguson (knee) is in line to miss multiple weeks, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: At a minimum, Ferguson is on track to miss at least this coming weekend's game against the 49ers, but a 'multiple week' timetable hints at a possible IR stint for the tight end. Next up for the Cowboy's reps at the position are Brevyn Spann-Ford, Luke Schoonmaker (groin) -- when healthy -- and James Mitchell. With the NFL trade deadline arriving Tuesday, it's also not difficult to imagine Dallas looking into…

news.headline: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said after Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts that Ferguson will undergo imaging on his knee Monday, the team's official site reports.
news.story: Ferguson played just 27 of the Cowboys' 79 offensive snaps and finished with two catches for 21 yards and a touchdown on two targets before exiting Sunday's game in the third quarter after taking a low hit. Schottenheimer noted that Ferguson initially sustained a stinger on the hit, but the Cowboys later classified his injury as a knee issue. The upcoming MRI will reveal the severity of the injury, which…

news.headline: Daniels is slated to take all of the first-teams reps Wednesday with Baker Mayfield (foot) sidelined for the Buccaneers' first Week 11 practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
news.story: While the Buccaneers aren't ruling Mayfield out from playing Sunday in Detroit, the fact that he'll be a spectator in practice coming out of a Week 10 bye suggests that Daniels has the early edge on the Week 11 start. Per Auman, Mayfield appeared to be walking normally off to the side during Wednesday's practice, which could indicate that he'll attempt to test out his strained foot during Thursday's session. The…

news.headline: Daniels "seems to be trending" toward drawing the start at quarterback for the Buccaneers on Sunday in Detroit while Baker Mayfield tends to a foot strain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
news.story: Mayfield injured his foot late in a Week 9 loss to the Bears, and after he was in and out of a walking boot during the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, his status is firmly up in the air for Week 11. Since Mayfield has shown a willingness to play at well below 100 percent in the past, the Buccaneers will likely wait until the end of the week to see where he stands on the health front before naming a starter for Sunday, but…

news.headline: Wright caught both of his targets for 11 yards during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
news.story: Wright tied season highs in both receiving yards and catches during Sunday's win, and his 39 snaps on offense were second-most among Lions tight ends behind Sam LaPorta (56). Wright has accumulated seven catches on eight target for 42 yards across nine regular-season games, and he's mostly served as a blocking tight end on the Lions' offense.

news.headline: Washington caught one pass for five yards on two targets in Sunday night's loss to the Bengals.
news.story: Aaron Rodgers threw for 143 yards in the game, and most of that came in garbage time in the second half with the score already out of hand. Washington has fewer than 30 receiving yards in seven of nine games played this season and is the epitome of a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option at tight end.

news.headline: Stowers failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
news.story: The rookie tight end ran just four routes on Joe Milton's 48 dropbacks against the G-Men. Grant Calcaterra ran just six, as the Eagles used more three-wide sets than multiple TE sets. Stowers would need a Dallas Goedert injury or trade to come into any fantasy value.

news.headline: McConkey (back) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: After missing the Chargers' last game with a back issue, McConkey's return to limited work is an encouraging step in his preparation for Week 11 against the Jets. His practice status over the rest of the week should provide more clarity on his availability for Sunday. There's no sugar-coating it that McConkey's season has been a complete disappointment to date, as he's battled multiple injuries that have caused him…

news.headline: McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action.
news.story: McConkey's next chance to play will thus arrive Nov. 22 against the Jets. In his absence versus Baltimore, Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris and KeAndre Lambert-Smith will be available to lead Los Angeles' WR corps.

news.headline: McConkey (back) is listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Ravens, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Although he was active for the Chargers' Week 9 loss to the Texans, McConkey didn't end up playing a single snap due to back spasms. His practice reps were restricted during Week 10 prep, and the questionable tag means McConkey's official status may not be known until the Chargers announce their list of inactive players approximately 90 minutes before Monday's 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff. If McConkey is ruled out or…

news.headline: Gadsden hauled in his lone target for seven yards in Monday's 23-20 win over Baltimore.
news.story: Gadsden went to the locker room during the first half of Monday's game after being poked in the ye, but the second-year tight end was cleared to return for the second quarter. However, his 12 offensive snaps were his lowest since Week 1 against the Cardinals (10), and that lack of playing time coincided with the return of veteran tight end David Njoku, who missed the Chargers' six prior games while on IR due to a…

news.headline: Gadsden (eye) returned to Monday night's game against the Ravens, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Gadsden was poked in the eye in the first quarter and had to go to the locker room before returning early in the second quarter. He wasn't targeted in the passing game prior to sustaining the injury.

news.headline: Gadsden (eye) is questionable to return to Monday's game against the Ravens.
news.story: It's unclear when Gadsden suffered the injury, but he went to the locker room midway through the first quarter. He wasn't targeted prior to leaving the contest. David Njoku and Charlie Kolar will handle tight-end duties for the Bolts while Gadsden is sidelined.

news.headline: Njoku played 19 offensive snaps but didn't get a target during Monday's 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday.
news.story: Njoku's snap count was predictably capped as he returned from a six-game absence due to a fibula injury that he sustained in Week 2 against the Raiders. His 19 offensive snaps were actually ahead of Oronde Gadsden (12), with Charlie Kolar leading all Chargers tight ends with 41 snaps on offense. With another week under his belt to get back up to speed, Njoku could be more involved in the Chargers' passing attack in…

news.headline: Njoku (fibula) officially is listed as active for Monday night's game against the Ravens, Omar Navarro of the Chargers' official site reports.
news.story: Since being designated for return from IR on Nov. 4, Njoku -- who last played in Week 2 -- logged five consecutive limited practice listings before upgrading to full participation Saturday and being deemed questionable for Monday's contest. With his return to the lineup now confirmed, Njoku will bolster a TE corps that also includes Charlie Kolar and Oronde Gadsden. In his only full game with the team this season,…

news.headline: The Chargers activated Njoku (fibula) from injured reserve ahead of Monday's game against the Ravens.
news.story: After completing his second week of practice upon being designated for return from IR on Nov. 4, Njoku had been listed as questionable heading into Monday. The Chargers ultimately came away encouraged enough by how Njoku looked during the week of practice to activate him, giving the team a third option at tight end for Monday's game. Due to his blocking prowess, Charlie Kolar likely will lead the position group in…

news.headline: Sadiq was limited to a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.story: On a day in which quarterbacks Geno Smith (ankle) and Cade Klubnik dropped back 45 times, Sadiq wasn't able to see much involvement in the passing game. Though the rookie first-round pick put his pass-catching chops on display with a 7-105-1 receiving line in Week 3 against Detroit, he's since delivered a collective 10-95-0 line on 19 targets over the Jets' ensuing seven contests. A lack of extended playing time…

news.headline: The conundrum picking Broncos' wide receivers in fantasy
Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
news.story: The four catches matched Engram's season high, and his 33 yards were his most since Week 5. It goes without saying, but Engram is well off the fantasy radar at tight end. He has 17 catches for 169 yards and one touchdown through nine games, averaging a career-low 18.8 yards per contest.

news.headline: Franklin brought in three of four targets for 31 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.story: Franklin drew a 27-yard pass interference penalty on the Broncos' second offensive play of the game, but the third-year wide receiver didn't log his first catch until early in the fourth quarter. He has operated in a rotational role for most of the season, and even with Jaylen Waddle in the league's concussion protocol, Franklin will likely maintain that workload following the Broncos' Week 10 bye.

news.headline: Mims caught one of two targets for zero yards, added a five-yard carry and returned three punts for 22 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.story: Nineteen of Mims' 24 snaps came on offense, although he logged only two touches in the process. He hasn't seen more than four targets in a game this season, with most of his output coming on special teams as a returner on both kickoffs and punts. The Broncos are on a bye for Week 10, so their next game will take place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22

news.headline: Trautman caught two of three passes for 15 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.story: Trautman failed to record a catch across six games between Weeks 2 and 7, but he has logged two receptions in each of his two outings. His 41 offensive snaps ended up being ahead of fellow tight end Evan Engram (38), although the latter has been more involved in the Broncos' offensive game plan than Trautman. The Broncos' next game takes place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22.

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate Sunday
Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.
news.story: It was another huge performance from the 27-year-old QB, as Lawrence set a new season high in passing yards and threw at least three TDs for the fifth time in nine games to begin the year. He spread the ball around again, as seven different Jaguars caught multiple passes and Parker Washington, Josh Cameron and Brenton Strange were all on the other end of scores. Lawrence will take a sharp 21:5 TD:INT into a Week 11…

news.headline: Adam Rank: Trevor Lawrence needs to be a must-start fantasy QB every week
Fantasy football free agent pickups: Replacing Drake Maye? Trust in Tyson?
McCarthy completed 23 of 36 passes for 293 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding six rushes for 34 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.
news.story: McCarthy continued to look like a competent NFL signal-caller in his third start for the Giants, posting a new career high in passing yards and adding a new season high in rushing yardage. His one touchdown pass was a critical one, as he hit Isaiah Likely over the middle for a 66-yard score just before the midway point of the fourth quarter to erase a 17-14 deficit. McCarthy has displayed excellent chemistry with…

news.headline: McCarthy (hip pointer) is "good to go" and isn't expected to be limited for Thursday's game against the Commanders, James Palmer of NFL Network reports.
news.story: McCarthy missed much of the third quarter of this past Sunday's win at Philadelphia due to a hip pointer but was able to return to action, completing 12 of 19 passes for 127 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions and rushing four times for 22 yards. Considering he ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back full practices, he seemingly was in the clear for Thursday's matchup, and Palmer's report indicates McCarthy will…

news.headline: Bartholomew caught three of four targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: With T.J. Hockenson (wrist) inactive, Bartholomew played 53 of 69 offensive snaps against Green Bay and caught the second of Kirk Cousins' two touchdowns, scoring from 20 yards out in the fourth quarter to give Minnesota a comfortable 27-10 lead. While Ben Yurosek got the start, Bartholomew played 13 more snaps and out-targeted Yurosek four to one. Cousins has an affinity for throwing to his tight ends, so…

news.headline: Felton is on track to operate in a more prominent role in Week 11 versus the 49ers, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Felton drew a start in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers, reeling in a season-high three of five targets for 33 yards over 56 offensive snaps. The wide receiver stepped into a starting role as a result of Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings (calf) being sidelined, and Addison is now reportedly set to undergo surgery to address his injury, opening the door for more opportunities for Felton moving forward.

news.headline: Felton went without a target while playing six of the Vikings' 48 offensive snaps in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.story: Felton continues to handle a muted role as a depth receiver for Minnesota, as Monday marked the third consecutive game in which he played single-digit snaps. For the season, the second-year wideout out of Maryland has been limited to just three receptions for 41 yards on seven targets over eight appearances.

news.headline: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
news.story: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this…

news.headline: Jennings (calf) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Green Bay.
news.story: Jennings opened Week 10 prep with back-to-back DNP listings due to a calf injury and now will miss his second contest of the campaign. With Jordan Addison (thumb) listed as questionable heading into the weekend, Justin Jefferson, Myles Price and Tai Felton currently are the healthy wide receivers on the Vikings' active roster.

news.headline: Jennings (calf) did not participate at practice Thursday.
news.story: Jennings was estimated as a non-participant on the Vikings' injury report Wednesday after being sidelined in Week 9, and he wasn't able to take the practice field Thursday. Unless he's able to return to practice in some capacity Friday, he'll probably end up missing a second straight game in Week 10, which could leave Myles Price with an expanded role at wideout come Sunday at Green Bay.

news.headline: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday, but Shanahan hopes the wide receiver will return to drills Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: If Evans gets back on the field Thursday, it'll mark his first on-field work since Week 6, when he aggravated a right Achilles injury. He's missed the past three games as a result -- benefiting from the 49ers' Week 9 bye -- and it appears how he fares in practice the next two days will determine if game action is possible Sunday against the Vikings in Mexico City.

news.headline: 49ers WR Mike Evans' Achilles tendinitis injury explained
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that the 49ers are "hoping to" have Evans (Achilles) back at practice this week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Evans missed the 49ers' last three games while recovering from right Achilles tendinitis, but he has a chance at returning to action in Week 11. After staying behind in the Bay Area this past weekend for the team's 46-40 win in Dallas, he's scheduled to meet back up with the 49ers this week in Colorado Springs, where the team will be holding practices at high altitude to get acclimated for Sunday's matchup with the…

news.headline: Fantasy football matchup ranks: Upgrade Jonah Coleman, downgrade Brock Purdy
Gesicki caught one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Gesicki caught six touchdowns in the first seven games of the season, but he's now produced just three grabs for 20 scoreless yards over the past two contests. The fluky touchdown rate was never going to hold up, and Joe Burrow funnels so many of his targets through Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins and Chase Brown that there isn't a whole lot more to go around to Cincinnati's ancillary weapons. Gesicki is a…

news.headline: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn ruled out Yankoff (knee) for Thursday night's games against the Giants, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.
news.story: Yankoff did not participate in Tuesday's walkthrough practice after missing Monday with a knee injury. Week 10 will be Washington's first game without the 26-year-old, though the injury is not presumed to be serious. Yankoff has three catches on five targets, for 22 yards through eight games.

news.headline: Yankoff (knee) did not participate in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Yankoff was sidelined for a second consecutive session while tending to a knee injury, which he likely picked up during the Commanders' 20-13 loss to the Rams on Sunday, when he hauled in his lone target for six yards. Wednesday is the Commanders' final practice of Week 10 prep, and the practice report will shed light on Yankoff's status against the Giants on Thursday Night Football.

news.headline: The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt (groin) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.
news.story: As a result of the transaction, the Commanders will have a 21-day window wherein they can evaluate Croskey-Merritt for a return to the 53-man roster. Depending on how he fares in practice during Week 11, Croskey-Merritt could be reinstated ahead of Monday's game against the Bengals. Whenever the Commanders elect to activate him, Croskey-Merritt will likely step back in as the team's lead runner, allowing Rachaad…

news.headline: Head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that while the 21-day practice window for Croskey-Merritt (groin) hasn't been opened yet, he notes that the running back is "trending in the right direction," Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Croskey-Merritt landed on IR back on Oct. 19, but now that the running back has missed the required four games his stint on the list entailed, he's eligible to return to practice once he's ready to do so. Quinn's comment Monday suggests that's not an imminent outcome, though Croskey-Merritt's Week 11 outlook could brighten by the time the Commanders' first injury report ahead of next Monday's game against the…
